jobs.title: Director, AI Engineering
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues - experts in their fields - who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients - who are at the heart of everything we do.

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.

Job Description:

The Director of AI Engineering, Corporate IT leads the engineering of artificial intelligence for internal enterprise delivery, from strategy and architecture through production delivery. This role builds secure, scalable and responsible AI capabilities that modernize enterprise systems, automate IT operations and improve employee productivity.

What will you do?

AI Strategy & Roadmap

Own the Corporate IT AI strategy and roadmap, aligned with CIO and enterprise priorities.
Lead intake, value assessment and prioritization of AI use cases across functions such as Actuarial, Risk, Compliance, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Procurement etc.
Manage AI licensing, vendor contracts and cloud spend within the IT budget.
Rationalize AI tools, reduce duplication and address unapproved or shadow AI use.
Assess emerging capabilities, including copilots, agents and SaaS AI features, for enterprise fit.

Enterprise AI Patterns, Architecture & Integration

Define AI patterns and align them with Enterprise Architecture standards.
Guide integration of AI with collaboration platforms and enterprise data services.
Govern build-versus-buy decisions across packaged AI, SaaS capabilities and custom solutions.
Align AI solutions with identity and access management, single sign-on, API gateways and enterprise data platforms.
Act as the AI design authority in relevant architecture review forums.

AI Platform, AIOps & Automation

Build and operate enterprise AI platform capabilities, including LLM gateways, retrieval-augmented generation, vector stores, prompt management and evaluation.
Deliver AIOps capabilities such as event correlation, anomaly detection and automated remediation.
Apply AI to IT service management, including ticket triage, routing, virtual agents and knowledge search.
Implement MLOps and LLMOps pipelines integrated with IT change and release management.
Monitor model quality, drift, hallucination risk, service performance and inference cost.

Security, Risk & Responsible AI

Embed information security, data classification and data loss prevention requirements across AI services.
Protect AI solutions against data leakage, prompt injection and model abuse.
Partner with Risk, Legal, Compliance and Privacy to establish and operate AI controls.
Support privacy, SOX, model-risk and audit requirements for AI-enabled corporate processes.
Maintain an accurate inventory of AI solutions and an approved-tools catalogue.

People, Talent & Adoption

Lead AI engineering, platform and automation teams and establish clear accountabilities.
Design roles, career paths and team structures that build sustainable AI capability within Corporate IT.
Mentor IT employees in AI engineering and secure, responsible AI practices.
Drive employee AI adoption and literacy in partnership with corporate function owners.
Manage strategic partners and managed service providers and hold them accountable for outcomes.

IT Service Delivery & Operations

Deliver AI initiatives through established portfolio, change, release and governance processes.
Own service-level expectations, support models, runbooks and operational readiness for AI services.
Partner with corporate function owners to define outcomes and realize measurable value.
Report value, risk, delivery and spend to the CIO and IT leadership.
Lead change management and communications for AI rollouts.

What do you need to succeed?

Demonstrated hands-on experience building and delivering artificial intelligence or machine learning solutions into production, supported by a strong foundation in software engineering, data engineering or machine learning.
Experience designing AI engineering patterns and guiding engineering teams through technical implementation while remaining actively involved in solution development.
Proficiency with Python and experience with data integration, data pipelines or extract, transform and load processes.
Experience with cloud AI services and application programming interfaces on Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure or both.
Practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, model evaluation and production monitoring.
Experience navigating information security, data protection, responsible AI and technology-governance requirements in a complex enterprise environment.
Ability to explain complex technical recommendations to engineering teams, senior leaders and business stakeholders, mentor colleagues and build alignment across teams.
Experience working in a regulated or highly governed enterprise environment.
Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure or AI-related training or certification.
Degree or advanced education in computer science, software engineering, data science, machine learning or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.

What's in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

We may use artificial intelligence to support candidate sourcing, screening, interview scheduling.

We thank all applicants for showing an interest in this position. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

135,000/135 000 - 195,000/195 000

IT - Application Development

jobs.title: Vice President Finance
jobs.description:
Vice President, Finance

Our Edmonton client is a privately held, internationally recognized healthcare technology organization providing specialized medical equipment, clinical solutions, and technical support to healthcare providers across North America. The company has established a reputation for operational excellence, strong customer partnerships, and a commitment to advancing patient care through innovative technologies.

Reporting to the CFO and serving as a key member of the leadership team, the Vice President, Finance will provide strategic and operational leadership for the organization’s global finance function.

This role is responsible for ensuring the integrity of financial reporting, planning, controls, taxation, treasury, and compliance while providing timely financial insight that supports business strategy, sustainable growth, and informed decision-making. The successful candidate will lead a global finance team and partner closely with executive leadership, Operations, Commercial, and other functional leaders to align financial priorities with business objectives.

This opportunity is ideally suited for a collaborative finance leader who combines strong technical expertise with business partnership skills and enjoys operating in a complex, multi-entity, global environment.

Key Responsibilities

The responsibilities of this role include, but are not limited to:

Lead the global finance function, including financial reporting, accounting, budgeting, forecasting, treasury, taxation, compliance, and financial governance.
Ensure timely and accurate financial reporting in compliance with applicable accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
Provide financial reporting, analysis, and insight to the Board, executive leadership, lenders, and other relevant stakeholders.
Oversee global consolidated reporting, annual audits, bank reporting, and financial oversight across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
Lead the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function, including budgeting, forecasting, scenario planning, financial modelling, and performance analysis.
Provide financial insight and recommendations to support strategic and operational decisions.
Establish and maintain an effective global financial control environment, including policies, approval authorities, segregation of duties, and financial governance practices.
Manage the company's cash flow and liquidity, including cash management, investment governance, debt management, and foreign exchange risk management.
Ensure compliance with tax, legal, and regulatory requirements, including transfer pricing and global reporting obligations.
Serve as the finance leader responsible for the ongoing maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of the global ERP system.
Partner with Operations, Commercial, and executive leadership to evaluate investments, growth opportunities, pricing decisions, and other strategic initiatives.
Lead, develop, and support a high-performing finance team by setting clear expectations, fostering accountability and engagement, providing regular coaching and feedback, and managing performance to achieve objectives.

Candidate Experience

While no individual will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional qualifications and personal competencies:

Recognized accounting designation (CPA).
University degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
10-15 years of progressive finance experience, including significant senior leadership experience.
Experience in global operations, manufacturing, or a similarly complex business environment.
Experience leading consolidated reporting, audits, budgeting, forecasting, treasury, taxation, and financial controls across multiple entities and jurisdictions.
Strong understanding of enterprise-scale global ERP systems and the ability to lead finance system optimization and adoption.
Advanced financial modelling, analysis, and reporting capabilities, including strong proficiency with Excel and enterprise reporting tools.
SAP experience is considered an asset.
In-depth knowledge of finance, accounting, budgeting, and cost accounting principles.
Strategic and commercially minded, with the ability to connect financial results to business priorities.
Demonstrates sound judgment, integrity, discretion, and accountability.
Builds trust and productive relationships across Operations, Commercial, and corporate functions.
Communicates complex financial information clearly to financial and non-financial audiences.
Demonstrates strong analytical, problem-solving, prioritization, and decision-making capabilities.
Strong leadership, coaching, and managerial skills.
Organized problem solver who excels in fast-paced environments and demonstrates strong judgment under pressure.

Location

Edmonton, AB

If you are interested in this role and meet the above criteria, please click the “Apply”
button to send your resume directly to Jay Borchert or Sumbul Hameed.

jobs.title: Director, Digital Commerce
jobs.description:
Overview

We are seeking a Director, Digital Commerce to lead PepsiCo Canada’s next phase of digital growth. This role will shape and deliver an integrated digital commerce strategy across customers, channels and brands. The Director will lead priority initiatives, embed digital commerce in omnichannel planning, build cross-functional partnerships and drive sustainable growth through strategic investment, capability building and talent development.

What you can expect from us:

Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits designed to fit your unique needs
A dynamic and inclusive culture that promotes you to bring your whole self to work
Inspiring positive change for people and the planet with sustainability goals
A supportive team that will encourage your professional growth and development

Responsibilities

Own PepsiCo Canada’s digital commerce strategy and roadmap, defining growth priorities, investments, milestones and performance measures.
Lead strategies for priority digital customers and platforms, including omnichannel retailers, Amazon and delivery partners.
Build senior customer partnerships and joint business plans across sales, assortment, content, retail media, availability, service and data sharing.
Embed digital commerce into commercial planning and ways of working across the organization.
Improve online assortment, availability, visibility, content quality and conversion by setting standards and addressing execution gaps.
Guide marketing and retail media investments, using performance and incremental growth to prioritize the strongest opportunities.
Advance data, analytics and technology capabilities by connecting dashboards and retailer data to improve decision-making.
Partner with supply chain and customer teams to improve fulfillment, in-stock performance and online assortment across digital channels.
Identify and scale new growth opportunities, including digital-first products, emerging platforms, new business models and pilot programs.
Lead and develop the digital commerce team, clarify accountabilities and build specialist capabilities.
Influence senior leaders, clarify trade-offs and secure the resources and decisions needed to deliver the strategy.
Translate customer, shopper and financial data into clear performance insights, risks and recommendations for senior leaders.

Qualifications

A post-secondary degree; advanced business education is an asset.
10+ years of progressive leadership experience in customer development, digital commerce, sales or marketing.
Proven success leading complex customer or channel strategies and cross-functional growth.
Strong knowledge of omnichannel retail, online grocery, digital marketplaces, retail media, digital shelf practices and shopper behaviour.
Experience with Amazon Vendor Central, retail media platforms, retailer data and performance marketing is an asset.
Strong commercial and financial acumen to balance growth, share, investment and profitability.
The ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
Proven ability to align senior stakeholders, challenge constructively and mobilize teams.
People leadership experience developing talent, clarifying accountabilities and building an inclusive, high-performance culture.
Entrepreneurial, agile and comfortable building capabilities in a fast-paced environment.
Exceptional communication and storytelling for customers and senior executives.

Careers to Smile About:

At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day.

At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve.

Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you.

PepsiCo may use Artificial Intelligence as part of its hiring process.  Specifically, we may use AI-based tools to screen, assess, or select applicants.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.
